description: Create a complete FastAPI microservice project structure from scratch. Create the following directory structure at /home/ga/workspace/notification_service/: (1) Directories: src/, tests/, docs/. (2) Files: src/__init__.py (can be empty), src/main.py (must contain: import FastAPI, create app instance like 'app = FastAPI()', define health check endpoint at /health using @app.get decorator that returns dict with 'status' key, define root endpoint at /), tests/__init__.py (can be empty), tests/test_main.py (must contain at least one function starting with 'test_'), docs/README.md (non-empty), .gitignore (must contain at least 3 Python patterns like __pycache__, *.pyc, .venv, .pytest_cache, .env), Dockerfile (must contain FROM instruction with 'python' in it, must contain CMD or ENTRYPOINT instruction, at least 4 lines total), pyproject.toml (must be valid TOML format, must have [project] or [tool.poetry] section, must specify project name like 'notification-service', must include 'fastapi' in dependencies), README.md in root (non-empty, should have project title). All Python files must have valid syntax. The health endpoint should return a dictionary like {'status': 'healthy'}.
